svg.title: OPTIMIZE: compaction
svg.desc: Before: Delta version 0 with files A to F in four Hive partitions. delta-maintenance optimize writes commit 1 that removes C and D and adds G. Afterwards Kusto reads the new file G, and often rereads unchanged files A, B, E and F.
svg.text: One commit swaps two small files for one bigger file. Kusto only needs the new file,
but it often reads the untouched files again too.
adds A, B, C, D, E, F
adds A, B, C, D, E, F
16-file tables (34 files): every trial reread unchanged files, 3 to 19 of 19 (up to 609.6 MiB).
In run 4 those reads reached the logs about 3 minutes after the watch window closed.
The 2-file table drawn here: 0 of 4 in all 8 trials. The 16-file table has the same shape, more files.
tombstoned (gone from the log, still on disk)
